Name: Sapling Scythe Protection
Author: Korporate
Description:
[color=#ffffff][b][size=4]Sapling Scythe Protection
[/size][/b]by Korporate

[b][size=4]What it does:
[/size][/b]The scythe and melee weapons no longer destroy tree saplings at growth stage 2 and 3 (growth stage 1 is a seed – non-applicable). For players who want to cut grass and weeds with the scythe without accidentally destroying nearby saplings. The hoe, axe, and pickaxe still behave as in base game.[/color]
[color=#ffffff]
[b][size=4]Requirements:
[/size][/b]Stardew Valley 1.6
SMAPI 4.0.0

[size=4][b]Notes:
[/b][/size]The game usually treats the scythe as a type of melee weapon.[/color]

Manifest.Name: Sapling Scythe Protection
Manifest.Description: Prevents the scythe and melee weapons from destroying tree saplings.
